Nina (Auditor): Hi team, small auditor follow-up for SOC2 evidence. We need a compact evidence bundle showing that the CMK rotation on 2025-12-08 preserved cryptographic provenance for objects written around that time and that no vulnerability remediation or incident coincided with the rotation. Specifically please provide:
- authoritative rotation mapping (old_arn -> new_arn) with timestamps and the principal that initiated rotation
- example S3 object versions (3-5 objects) showing SSEKMS KeyId in head-object for versions written before and after rotation
- CloudTrail extract showing any ReEncrypt/Encrypt/Decrypt calls tied to a background job (if rewraps happened)
- IAM role snapshots immediately before/after rotation and CloudTrail entry for the actor who performed EnableKeyRotation or CreateKey
- cross-check whether any active vuln tickets or incident runbooks were open during the window (link JIRA/incident id)
Need this by EOD Thursday. One-paragraph narrative that states how artifacts demonstrate continuity would be helpful.

Sana (security): @Nina ack. I'll assemble the rotation mapping and role snapshots. Tagging @Raj for S3 metadata pulls and @Omar for CloudTrail/alerts correlation. ci-bot please run evidence-export-job when we have artifacts.

Raj (infra): Running S3 version and head-object queries now. Example commands I'm using:
```
# list versions in that day range
aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket redwood-artifacts-prod --prefix models/ \
  --query "Versions[?LastModified>=`2025-12-08T00:00:00Z` && LastModified<=`2025-12-09T00:00:00Z`].{Key:Key,VersionId:VersionId,LastModified:LastModified}"

# head-object for each version to capture SSE data
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts-prod --key "models/example.bin" --version-id <VID>
# look for ServerSideEncryption, SSEKMSKeyId, Metadata
```
I'll output CSV columns: object_key,version_id,last_modified,sse_kms_keyid,server_side_encryption

Omar (oncall): Pulled CloudTrail events for kms and s3 re-encrypt. Splunk query I used:
```
index=cloudtrail (eventName=EnableKeyRotation OR eventName=CreateKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt) earliest="2025-12-08T00:00:00" latest="2025-12-09T00:00:00"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters additionalEventData
```
No active oncall alerts tied to rotation window. I also checked incident manager for any runbook executions with start time in window and found none.

Sana (security): Rotation mapping: we have CloudTrail record showing old CMK arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/aaa111 and new arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/bbb222 at 2025-12-08T03:22:11Z. Principal: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/key-admins (role assumed by ops-deploy). I'll include the full event JSON in the bundle.

Nina (Auditor): Two follow-ups: 1) If any objects were re-encrypted by a background job, please list job id and exact object versions touched. 2) For role snapshots, can you provide the policy diff so we can see there was no privilege elevation during rotation?

Raj (infra): Found a rewrap background job (job id rewrap-job-20251208-17). It re-encrypted 12 objects (we'll include the list) at 2025-12-08T05:40:02Z. The job logs show it called S3 CopyObject with SSEKMSKeyId set to new CMK; CloudTrail shows ReEncrypt activity for those version ids. We'll flag those rows in the CSV.

Omar (oncall): JIRA check: no active critical vuln remediation tickets assigned to infra during rotation. There is a low-sev ticket (RDW-5123) for dependency upgrade in progress, not related. I'll include a snapshot of the JIRA ticket list filtered by assignee date range.

ci-bot: evidence-export-7943210001 queued by @Sana (security) 1:11: starting bundle creation.

Sana (security): I'll create a proof bundle containing:
- kms_rotation_cloudtrail_20251208.csv
- s3_versions_kms_metadata_20251208.csv (flags for rewrapped objects)
- iam_role_snapshot_before_after_20251208.txt (including policy diff)
- rewrap_job_logs_rewrap-job-20251208-17.log
- jira_snapshot_20251208.csv
- narrative_20251208.txt (one paragraph explaining continuity and caveats)

Nina (Auditor): Please in the narrative explicitly state: "Objects not re-encrypted retain original SSEKMSKeyId in S3 metadata; re-encrypted objects have CloudTrail ReEncrypt entries referencing job id rewrap-job-20251208-17." That will make audit verification quick.

Sana (security): Will do. Uploading to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2025-12-08/ now. presigned link will be posted when ready.

ci-bot: evidence-export-7943210001 completed by @Sana 1:45. presigned link: https://redwood-files.example/7943210001/proof-bundle.zip (valid 7 days)

Nina (Auditor): Received, thanks. I'll review and follow up if anything needs more detail. If all good we'll close the control for that rotation window. :white_check_mark:

Sana (security): Thanks team. If auditor needs deeper cryptographic proof (e.g., envelope key wrapping logs from HSM/EKM) we can pull EKM audit logs but need ops approval. Ping me if requested.

Omar (oncall): noted, no incidents correlated. ci-bot archived the evidence job record (id 7943210001).
